3301.meaning1: becoming settled (towards); making up one's mind (about); having faith (in); inclining (towards)
3301.meaning2: becoming settled (towards); making up one's mind (about); having faith (in); inclining (towards); lit. being released towards
3301.commentary: (NIDD1a) adhimuccantā'ti sampasādanavasena sanniṭṭhānaṃ katvā tesaṃ kathaṃ adhivāsentā.

examples.text: cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto sikkheyya, saddhāya adhimuccanto sikkheyya, vīriyaṃ paggaṇhanto sikkheyya, satiṃ upaṭṭhapento sikkheyya

3302.commentary: (SNa) evaṃ adhimuccamāno'ti evaṃ adhimuccanto bhikkhu dubbal'ūpanissaye ṭhito pañc'oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni chindeyya. (ANa) cetasā adhimuccamāno'ti cittena sanniṭṭhāpayamāno.

examples.text: tatra kho bhagavā udānaṃ udānesi, no c'assaṃ, no ca me siyā, n'ābhavissa, na me bhavissatī'ti, evaṃ adhimuccamāno bhikkhu chindeyya oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanānī'ti.
katame satta? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassī viharati, aniccasaññī, aniccapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno.

3305.meaning1: who has made up one's mind; who has faith; who accepts; who trusts
3305.commentary: (ANa) taṃ khippaññ'eva adhimuccitā hotī'ti taṃ vaṇṇaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ vā sīgham'eva saddahati. saddahan'aṭṭhena hi ādānena esa ādiyanamukho'ti vutto.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo ādheyyamukho hoti? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo parassa vaṇṇe vā avaṇṇe vā bhāsiyamāne taṃ khippaññ'eva adhimuccitā hoti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo ādheyyamukho hoti.

3306.meaning1: having focused; having resolved; having fixed the mind (on)
3306.commentary: (MNa) yaṃ pana sabbavāresu pharitvā adhimuccitvā'ti vuttaṃ, tattha pañcavidhaṃ pharaṇaṃ cetopharaṇaṃ kasiṇapharaṇaṃ dibbacakkhupharaṇaṃ ālokapharaṇaṃ sarīrapharaṇan'ti. tattha cetopharaṇaṃ nāma lokadhātusahasse sattānaṃ cittajānanaṃ. kasiṇapharaṇaṃ nāma lokadhātusahasse kasiṇapattharaṇaṃ. dibbacakkhupharaṇaṃ nāma ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā dibbena cakkhunā sahassalokadhātudassanaṃ. ālokapharaṇampi etadeva. sarīrapharaṇaṃ nāma lokadhātusahasse sarīrapabhāya pattharaṇaṃ. sabbattha imāni pañca pharaṇāni avināsentena kathetabban'ti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso ekaṃ āmaṇḍaṃ hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sahasso brahmā sahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
anissaraṇadassāvī, gandhe ce paṭisevati, na so muccati dukkhamhā, gandhesu adhimucchito.

3309.meaning1: having made an intention; having determined; having fixed the mind (on)

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekacco purisapuggalo ākiñcaññ'āyatana-adhimutto assa.
sadā jāgaramānānaṃ, ahoratt'ānusikkhinaṃ, nibbānaṃ adhimuttānaṃ, atthaṃ gacchanti āsavā.

3311.meaning1: accustomed (to); habituated (to); firm (in); established (in); dedicated (to); firmly entrenched (in)

examples.text: yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti
so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti, nekkhamma-adhimutto hoti, paviveka-adhimutto hoti, abyāpajja-adhimutto hoti, taṇhākkhaya-adhimutto hoti, upādānakkhaya-adhimutto hoti, asammoha-adhimutto hoti.

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃnhāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā adhimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttam'aṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhapeyya

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃnhāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā adhimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttam'aṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhapeyya

3314.meaning1: thus mentally inclined; having such a conviction
3314.meaning2: whose mind is so inclined; who has such a conviction
3314.commentary: (NIDD2) adhimuttacittan'ti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ nibbān'ādhimuttan'ti, evaṃ maṃ dhārehi adhimuttacittan'ti. (SNPa) evaṃ maṃ dhārehi adhimuttacittan'ti piṅgiyo evam'eva tvam'pi pamuñcassu saddhan'ti. iminā bhagavato ovādena attani saddhaṃ uppādetvā saddhādhuren'eva ca vimuñcitvā taṃ saddh'ādhimuttataṃ pakāsento bhagavantaṃ āha, evaṃ maṃ dhārehi adhimuttacittan'ti. ayam'ettha adhippāyo yathā maṃ tvaṃ avaca, evam'eva adhimuttaṃ dhārehī'ti.

examples.text: asaṃhīraṃ asaṅkuppaṃ, yassa n'atthi upamā kvaci, addhā gamissāmi na m'ettha kaṅkhā, evaṃ maṃ dhārehi adhimuttacittan'ti.

3315.meaning2: fact of being devoted to; fact of being fully engaged in

examples.text: sabbe dhammā buddhassa bhagavato āvajjana-paṭibaddhā ākaṅkha-paṭibaddhā manasikāra-paṭibaddhā citt'uppāda-paṭibaddhā. sabbasattesu buddhassa bhagavato ñāṇaṃ pavattati, sabbesañ'ca sattānaṃ bhagavā āsayaṃ jānāti anusayaṃ jānāti caritaṃ jānāti adhimuttiṃ jānāti.

3320.meaning1: having a disposition; with an inclination; with a tendency; with a propensity

3322.meaning1: fact of having a certain disposition; state of having an inclination; fact of having a propensity
3322.construction:
adhi + √muc + ti + ka + tā
adhimuttika + tā

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato sattānaṃ nānā-adhimuttikataṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

3323.meaning1: theoretical speculation; speculative theory; (comm) explanation of one's view
3323.commentary: (DNa) adhimuttipadānī'ti adhivacanapadāni. atha vā bhūtaṃ atthaṃ abhibhavitvā yathāsabhāvato aggahetvā pavattanato adhimuttiyo'ti diṭṭhiyo vuccanti. adhimuttīnaṃ padāni adhimuttipadāni, diṭṭhidīpakāni vacanānī'ti attho.

examples.text: bhagavā etadavoca, santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā apar'antakappikā apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhino apar'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhimuttipadāni abhivadanti.

ye ca paṭhame jhāne dhammā vitakko ca vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañ'ca citt'ek'aggatā ca, phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittaṃ chando adhimokkho vīriyaṃ sati upekkhā manasikāro, ty'āssa dhammā anupadavavatthitā honti.

3326.meaning1: due to firm intention; due to fixed resolve

examples.text: so ce evaṃ vadeyya, mānusakehi me kāmehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, cātumahārājikesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocitan'ti, so evam'assa vacanīyo, cātumahārājikehi kho, āvuso, devehi tāvatiṃsā devā abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca.

3328.meaning2: makes incline to; sets on; makes enter (another's body)

examples.text: sādh'āyasmā, mānusakehi kāmehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā cātumahārājikesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocehī'ti.
ty'āhaṃ mante adhiyāmi sācariyako'ti, tāvatā tvaṃ bhavissasi isi vā isitthāya vā paṭipanno'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

3330.meaning1: wanting to study; wishing to learn; wanting to recite

examples.text: bhavañ'hi soṇadaṇḍo bahūnaṃ ācariyapācariyo tīṇi māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti. bahū kho pana nānādisā nānājanapadā māṇavakā āgacchanti bhoto soṇadaṇḍassa santike mant'atthikā mante adhiyitu'kāmā…

3331.meaning1: to study; to learn by heart; to recite

examples.text: khattiyā bhogā rājāno, anuyantā bhavanti te, rājā-adhirājā manuj'indo, rajjaṃ kārehi gotama.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, āraññako mago baddho pāsarāsiṃ adhisayeyya. so evam'assa veditabbo, anayam'āpanno byasanam'āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo luddassa.

3336.commentary: (SNa) adhisayitānī'ti tāya ca janettiyā kukkuṭiyā pakkhe pasāretvā tesaṃ upari sayantiyā sammā adhisayitāni.

examples.text: tān'assu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā pariseditāni sammā paribhāvitāni

3337.meaning1: is too ascetic; is too austere; is too strict; (comm) makes too much effort
3337.meaning2: is too much of an effacer, is too exacting
3337.commentary: (MNa) adhisallikhat'ev'āyan'ti ayaṃ samaṇo navanītaṃ pisanto viya padumanāḷasuttaṃ kakacena okkantanto viya atisallekhati, ativāyāmaṃ karoti.

examples.text: evam'eva pan'udāyi, idh'ekacce moghapurisā idaṃ pajahathā'ti mayā vuccamānā te evam'āhaṃsu, kiṃ pan'imassa appamattakassa oramattakassa adhisallikhat'ev'āyaṃ samaṇo'ti.

3338.meaning1: is too ascetic; is too austere; is too hard core

examples.text: atha kho kassapagottassa bhikkhuno bhagavati sikkhāpadapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya bhikkhū sandassente samādapente samuttejente sampahaṃsente ahu'd'eva akkhanti ahu appaccayo, adhisallekhat'ev'āyaṃ samaṇo'ti.
adhisīlaṃ adhicittaṃ, adhipaññañ'ca vīriyavā, thāmavā dhitimā jhāyī, sato gutt'indriyo care.
tisso imā, bhikkhave, sikkhā. katamā tisso? adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā.

3341.meaning1: training in higher virtue; development of higher conduct; (comm) vinayapiṭaka
3341.commentary: (VINa) adhisīlasikkhā'ti adhikaṃ uttamaṃ sīlan'ti adhisīlaṃ, adhisīlañ'ca taṃ sikkhitabbato sikkhā cā'ti adhisīlasikkhā. (VINa) tathā hi, vinayapiṭake visesena adhisīlasikkhā vuttā, sutt'antapiṭake adhicittasikkhā, abhidhammapiṭake adhipaññāsikkhā.

examples.text: tisso imā, bhikkhave, sikkhā. katamā tisso? adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā.
sikkhā'ti tisso sikkhā, adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā. tatra y'āyaṃ adhisīlasikkhā, ayaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetā sikkhā'ti.

3342.meaning1: undertaking the training in higher ethical conduct
3342.commentary: (ANa) adhisīlasikkhāsamādānan'ti-ādīsu samādānaṃ vuccati gahaṇaṃ, adhisīlasikkhāya samādānaṃ gahaṇaṃ pūraṇaṃ adhisīlasikkhāsamādānaṃ. sesapadadvaye'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: adhisīlasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhicittasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhipaññāsikkhāsamādānaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi samaṇassa samaṇiyāni samaṇakaraṇīyāni.

3343.meaning1: regards to ethical conduct; concerning moral integrity; (comm) highest ethical behaviour
3343.commentary: (DNa) yadidaṃ adhisīlan'ti yaṃ etaṃ uttamaṃ sīlan'ti attho. iti imaṃ paṭhamaṃ sīhanādaṃ nadati.

examples.text: yāvatā, kassapa, ariyaṃ paramaṃ sīlaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi, kuto bhiyyo! atha kho aham'eva tattha bhiyyo, yadidaṃ adhisīlaṃ.

3344.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of adhisīla
3344.meaning1: with regard to morality; about ethics

examples.text: idh'udāyi, mamaṃ sāvakā adhisīle sambhāventi, sīlavā samaṇo gotamo paramena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato'ti.

3345.commentary: (DHPa) ayaṃ kāyo pathaviṃ adhisessati, imissā pakatisayanena sayitāya pathaviyā upari sayissati.

examples.text: aciraṃ vat'ayaṃ kāyo, pathaviṃ adhisessati, chuddho apetaviññāṇo, niratthaṃ'va kaliṅgaraṃ.
upamā kho my'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, katā atthassa viññāpanāya. ayaṃ c'ev'ettha attho, samatittiko telapatto'ti kho, bhikkhave, kāyagatāya etaṃ satiyā adhivacanaṃ.

daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā'ti kho, bhikkhave, kāyagatāya satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tasmā't'iha vo, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kāyagatā no sati bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā'ti.

3350.meaning1: pathway of expression; mode of designation

examples.text: tayo'me, bhikkhave, niruttipathā adhivacanapathā paññattipathā asaṅkiṇṇā asaṅkiṇṇapubbā, na saṅkīyanti, na saṅkīyissanti, appaṭikuṭṭhā samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi. katame tayo?

yehi, ānanda, ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi yehi uddesehi nāmakāyassa paññatti hoti, tesu ākāresu tesu liṅgesu tesu nimittesu tesu uddesesu asati api nu kho rūpakāye adhivacanasamphasso paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

3353.meaning1: extra speech; further address; additional ceremony

3354.meaning1: occurs a lot (for); exists in abundance (for); happens frequently; (comm) covers over; submerges
3354.commentary: (ANa) sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti sukhañ'ca etaṃ puggalaṃ adhivattati, avattharatī'ti attho.

examples.text: patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhaṃc'etaṃadhivattatī.

tesam'pi, bhante, dhanayuddhānaṃ n'atthi gati n'atthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe. adhivattamāne ca me, bhante, jarāmaraṇe kim'assa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāyā'ti?

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse māluvāsipāṭikā phaleyya. atha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, māluvābījaṃ aññatarasmiṃ sālamūle nipateyya. atha kho, bhikkhave, yā tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthā devatā sā bhītā saṃviggā santāsaṃ āpajjeyya.

3361.commentary: (ANa) jāti'pi dukkhā'tiādinā nayena vuttaṃ dukkhaṃ adhivahati āharatī'ti dukkh'ādhivahaṃ. dukkh'ādhivāhan'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, lok'uttarapādakajjhān'ādi ariyadhamm'ābhimukhaṃ dukkhena adhivāhīyati pesīyatī'ti dukkh'ādhivāhaṃ. idam'pi vaṭṭavasena uppannacittam'eva. tañ'hi vuttappakārā devamanussādisampattiyo dadamānampi jāti-ādīnaṃ adhivahanato dukkh'ādhivahaṃ, ariyadhammādhigamāya duppesanato dukkh'ādhivāhañ'ca nāma hotī'ti.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ abhāvitaṃ abahulīkataṃ dukkha-adhivahaṃ hoti yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ. cittaṃ, bhikkhave, abhāvitaṃ abahulīkataṃ dukkha-adhivahaṃ hotī'ti.
uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātikā bhavissāmā'ti

3364.commentary: (VISMa) tathā koṭṭhāsabhāvanāya attasinehassa parikkhīṇattā bhayabheravaṃ sahati, sīt'ādīnañ'ca adhivāsakajātiko hoti.

examples.text: uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātikā bhavissāmā'ti

3365.commentary: (MNa) dassanā pahātabbā'ti dassanena pahātabbā. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa, jighacchāya pipāsāya
adhivāsetu dāni, bhante, bhagavā, adhivāsetu sugato, adhivāsanakālo dāni, bhante, bhagavato. yena yen'eva dāni bhagavā gamissati taṃninnā'va gamissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca.

3367.meaning1: time to consent; (or) time to endure

examples.text: adhivāsetu dāni, bhante, bhagavā, adhivāsetu sugato, adhivāsanakālo dāni, bhante, bhagavato. yena yen'eva dāni bhagavā gamissati taṃninnā'va gamissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca.

3369.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from adhivāseti, caus (+gen)

examples.text: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.

3370.grammar: nt, instr sg of adhivāsana, caus
3370.meaning1: by means of enduring; through tolerating
3370.construction:
adhi + vāse + ana + ā
adhivāsana + ā
3370.commentary: (MNa) dassanā pahātabbā'ti dassanena pahātabbā. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā dassanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā saṃvarā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā vinodanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā bhāvanā pahātabbā.

3371.grammar: prp of adhivāseti, irreg form of adhivāsenta, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: ātaṅkaphassena khudāya phuṭṭho, sītaṃ atuṇhaṃ adhivāsayeyya, so tehi phuṭṭho bahudhā anoko, vīriyaṃ parakkammadaḷhaṃ kareyya.
phuṭṭho ḍaṃsehi makasehi, araññasmiṃ brahāvane, nāgo saṅgāmasīs'eva, sato tatra-adhivāsaye.
app'ossukko dāni tuvaṃ kapota, vihaṅ'gama na tava bhojan'attho, khudaṃ pipāsaṃ adhivāsayanto, kasmā bhavaṃposathiko kapota.
atha kho bhagavā te licchavī etadavoca, adhivāsitaṃ kho me, licchavī, svātanāya ambapāliyā gaṇikāya bhattan'ti.

3375.meaning1: should be endured; must be tolerated
3375.meaningLit: to cause to be lived through

examples.text: adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā'ti. adhivāsesi bhagavā tuṇhībhāvena.
adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo verañjāyaṃ vass'āvāsaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā'ti
bhusā sudaṃ bhagavato vedanā vattanti sārīrikā vedanā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā asātā amanāpā, tā sudaṃ bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāseti avihaññamāno.
tañ'ce bhikkhu adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti

3379.meaning1: to endure; to tolerate; to bear

examples.text: pabbajitassa hi saddhivihārik'ādayo, gahaṭṭhassa putt'ādayo hatthi-ass'ādayo vā sattā piyā honti keḷāyitā mamāyitā, muhuttam'pi te apassanto adhivāsetuṃ na sakkoti.
sādhu kira, bhante, āyasmā ānando yena bhikkhun'upassayo yena sā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti. adhivāsesi kho āyasmā ānando tuṇhībhāvena.
adhivāsesi bhagavā tuṇhībhāvena
tatra su'daṃ bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāsesi avihaññamāno. atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, na kho me taṃ patirūpaṃ, yo'haṃ anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parinibbāyeyyaṃ.
cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanā adantā aguttā arakkhitā asaṃvutā dukkha-adhivāhā honti. katame cha? cakkhu, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanaṃ adantaṃ aguttaṃ arakkhitaṃ asaṃvutaṃ dukkha-adhivāhaṃ hoti
vīriyaṃ me dhuradhorayhaṃ, yogakkhema-adhivāhanaṃ, gacchati anivattantaṃ, yattha gantvā na socati.

3387.commentary: (THa) papañca-saṅghāta-dukh'ādhivāhinin'ti sattasantānaṃ saṃsāre papañcenti vitthārentī'ti papañcā, rāg'ādayo mān'ādayo ca. te eva pavattidukkhassa saṅghāt'aṭṭhena saṅghātā, sadarathapariḷāhasabhāvattā dukkhañ'cā'ti papañca-saṅghāta-dukhaṃ, tassa adhivāhato nibbattanato papañca-saṅghāta-dukh'ādhivāhinī.

examples.text: yadā dukkhass'āvahaniṃ visattikaṃ, papañca-saṅghāta-dukha-adhivāhiniṃ, taṇhaṃ pahantvāna sato'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
evañ'ca vadeti, adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ gotamo bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā'ti. adhivuṭṭhañ'ca pana samaṇena gotamenā'ti.
ye te, ānanda, dhammā tesaṃ tesaṃ adhivuttipadānaṃ abhiññā sacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti, visārado ahaṃ, ānanda, tattha paṭijānāmi.

3392.commentary: (MNa) adhivuttipadānī'ti adhivacanapadāni. atha vā bhūtam'atthaṃ adhibhavitvā yathāsabhāvato aggahetvā vattanato adhivuttiyo'ti diṭṭhiyo vuccanti, adhivuttīnaṃ padāni adhivuttipadāni, diṭṭhidīpakāni vacanānī'ti attho.

examples.text: ye te, ānanda, dhammā tesaṃ tesaṃ adhivuttipadānaṃ abhiññā sacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti, visārado ahaṃ, ānanda, tattha paṭijānāmi.
bhagavā etadavoca, santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā apar'antakappikā apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhino apar'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti.

3394.synonym: ajjhāvuṭṭha, ajjhāvuttha, abhinivuṭṭha, abhinivuttha, āvuṭṭha, āvuttha, nisevita

examples.text: tatr'evaṃ katikā kātabbā, ekasmiṃ vihāre sannipatitehi bhikkhūhi yaṃ vihāraṃ saṅgaṇhitu'kāmā samānalābhaṃ kātuṃ icchanti, tassa nāmaṃ gahetvā asuko nāma vihāro porāṇako'ti vā buddha-adhivuttho'ti vā appalābho'ti vā yaṃkiñci kāraṇaṃ vatvā taṃ vihāraṃ iminā vihārena saddhiṃ ekalābhaṃ kātuṃ saṅghassa ruccatī'ti tikkhattuṃ sāvetabbaṃ.
adhivāsetu kira, bhante, bhagavā lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā'ti. adhivutthañ'ca pana tena bhagavatā'ti.
alaṃ, mahārāja. adhivuttho me vass'āvāso'ti.
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave puriso dāso assa anatta-adhīno par'ādhīno na yenakāmaṃgamo
ubho atthaṃ na jānanti, ubho dhammaṃ na passare, yo c'āyaṃ mantaṃ vāceti, yo c'ādhammen'adhīyati.
so aṭṭhacattālīsavassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno.
